history.summary: FLAG - UNCERTAIN IDENTITY / GENERIC NAME: 'Kali Mandir' is the name of several shrines in Hazaribagh and no single canonical referent exists. Documented here is the Kali Mandir at North Shivpuri, Hazaribagh (Justdial 4.4/156 ratings; indiainfo lists Kali Mandir, Shivpuri, Hazaribagh 825301), the most-reviewed in-town listing. Other same-named shrines include the Kali Mandir at Kachanpur near Chadwa Dam (Justdial 4.7/95 ratings, described in devotee videos as a peaceful lakeside shrine), Kaali Baadi at Nawabganj (4.5/175 ratings), and a Kaali Temple at Kumhartoli. No founding history, builder, or festival record for any of these was found in web sources - placeholder entry. Coordinates are from the geocoded North Shivpuri address.

name: Kali Mandir
town: Hazaribagh (CSV 'Hazaribag' is the same district town; referent mapped to North Shivpuri)
town_description: Hazaribagh is the headquarters of Hazaribagh district in Jharkhand, a plateau town known for its lakes, wildlife sanctuary, and as a gateway to pilgrimage sites like Surajkund and Rajrappa. It hosts several small Kali and Shiva shrines across its mohallas.

travel.airport: Birsa Munda Airport, Ranchi is the nearest major airport (~90-100 km - verify).
travel.railway: Hazaribagh Town station is the nearest railhead (verify); Koderma Junction is the nearest major junction.
travel.road: North Shivpuri is within Hazaribagh town; reachable by local auto/taxi (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather; Kali Puja (October-November) is the grandest period (verify).
visitor_information.opening_hours: Not documented (verify). Typical small-town Kali shrines open mornings and evenings.
